title: The Language Café
text:
Students at a university in Chiang Mai can now practice foreign languages for free at a new "language café" on campus. The café, (1) opened last month, is run by international students (2) volunteer two hours a week. Visitors choose a table for the language they want to practice and simply start (3). No textbooks are allowed.
"The idea is to make speaking feel natural, not like a test," said the organizer, (4) came to Thailand from Germany three years ago. So far, the English and Chinese tables have been the most popular, (5) the Japanese table is often empty. The organizers hope to attract more Japanese speakers (6) the end of the term.
Students say the café has helped them overcome their fear of making mistakes. "Before, I was too shy (7) a word," said one second-year student. "Now I speak English (8) day." The university will open two more cafés next year if the project (9) successful. It has also asked local businesses (10) coffee and snacks.

items.stem: (1) The café, ___ opened last month, is run by international students … volunteer two hours a week.
why_wrong: หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
who ใช้กับคน
where ใช้เมื่อข้างหลังครบประโยค
items.explanation_th: ขยาย The café หลัง comma + ประธาน → which

items.stem: (2) The café, … opened last month, is run by international students ___ volunteer two hours a week.
why_wrong: which ใช้กับสิ่ง
whose ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม
whom ใช้ในตำแหน่งกรรม
items.explanation_th: ขยายคน + ประธานของ volunteer → who

items.stem: (3) Visitors choose a table for the language they want to practice and simply start ___.
why_wrong: talked ผิดรูป
talks ผิดรูป

items.stem: (4) said the organizer, ___ came to Thailand from Germany three years ago.
why_wrong: which ใช้กับสิ่ง
หลัง comma ใช้ that ไม่ได้
whose ต้องตามด้วยคำนาม
items.explanation_th: ขยายคน (the organizer) หลัง comma → who

items.stem: (5) So far, the English and Chinese tables have been the most popular, ___ the Japanese table is often empty.
why_wrong: so ไม่สมเหตุผล
because ไม่สมเหตุผล
unless ไม่สมเหตุผล
items.explanation_th: เปรียบต่าง (โต๊ะหนึ่งนิยม อีกโต๊ะว่าง) → while

items.stem: (6) The organizers hope to attract more Japanese speakers ___ the end of the term.
why_wrong: since + จุดเริ่ม ไม่ใช่กำหนดเวลา
during ไม่ใช้บอกกำหนดเวลา
on the end of ผิด
items.explanation_th: by the end of = ภายในสิ้น…

items.stem: (7) "Before, I was too shy ___ a word,"

ขาด to
for saying ผิด

items.stem: (9) The university will open two more cafés next year if the project ___ successful.
why_wrong: หลัง if ไม่ใช้ will
was ใช้กับแบบที่ 2
หลัง if ไม่ใช้ would
items.explanation_th: If แบบที่ 1 → หลัง if ใช้ปัจจุบัน is
